prompts.name: Acoustic Sculpture

variants.a: An instrument of seven copper plates and a story of spaces
variants.b: A sound character workshop with a comparison of scenarios

prompts.signature: Seven matte copper plates; a stable lit scene; three characters to choose from
prompts.acceptance: The scenario and character choices carry over into a validated enquiry that can be copied; sound only after it is deliberately turned on; a clear mute.

prompts.name: Seasonal Terrain

variants.a: A soil section and a seasonal story
variants.b: A seasons calendar with a basket-building flow

prompts.signature: A relief of three soil layers; a fixed camera; the season changes the plants and the produce
prompts.acceptance: Season, size and frequency make a consistent basket summary; the layer markers work with the keyboard.

prompts.name: Resonant Ribbon

variants.a: The making story of a single wooden ribbon
variants.b: A macro gallery of three instruments and a character picker

prompts.signature: One painted wooden ribbon; its shape changes in stages; a tangible instrument character
prompts.acceptance: Instrument, character and wood tone make up the enquiry; sound is optional and the key information is given in text.

prompts.name: Modular Light

variants.a: A catalogue spread for a modular lamp
variants.b: An assembly workbench with a numbered exploded view

prompts.signature: Five paper and aluminium modules; a controllable exploded view; a visible cone of light
prompts.acceptance: The number of modules, the shade and the purpose change the object and the size summary; export and undo work.

prompts.name: Twilight Expedition

variants.a: A panorama from twilight to night and three arrival sections
variants.b: A relief route atlas with a time and stop plan

prompts.signature: One stable panorama; twilight turns into night; a limited camera shift
prompts.acceptance: Route, length and participants update the stops and the enquiry; no pretend weather or bookings.

prompts.name: Light Environments

variants.a: An exhibition story of three different spaces
variants.b: A table for building a personal exhibition route

prompts.signature: An amphitheatre, a fabric vault and a shadow valley; different silhouettes; a controllable light direction
prompts.acceptance: Environments can be added to the route, reordered, removed, saved locally and exported.

prompts.name: Discovery Cabinet

variants.a: A radial table of six seed jars
variants.b: A vertical discovery drawer and a collection tray

prompts.signature: Six individual jars; lids that open; a tray of choices
prompts.acceptance: All six seeds are reachable without dragging; the collection can be added to, removed from and exported; the sprout is marked as an interpretation.

prompts.name: Woven Field

variants.a: A creative weaving notebook with a field of threads
variants.b: A pattern-making studio and large collection samples

prompts.signature: A field of taut threads; a limited palette of linen, green and rust; a woven structure
prompts.acceptance: Density, two colours and three weaves really change the original SVG; the whole self-contained SVG can be exported.

prompts.name: Choreographic Stage

variants.a: An asymmetric movement stage and three performance sections
variants.b: A session programme led by format and experience

prompts.signature: An abstract aerial dance figure; a finite path; the rhythm of performances
prompts.acceptance: The format and experience filters change the demonstration programme; the copied enquiry includes the chosen fields.

prompts.name: Repair Atlas

variants.a: The story of a chair being assembled and taken apart
variants.b: A materials catalogue of six objects and a repair route

prompts.signature: A segmented wooden chair; disassembly labels; one replaceable joint
prompts.acceptance: Filters for six objects, a route of 2–4 stops, reordering, removal and export work; the capacity limits are clear.

prompts.name: Balcony Builder

variants.a: A bold planter box offer and how it grows
variants.b: A three-step workshop for picking a balcony kit

prompts.signature: A modular planter box; botanical illustration; assembling the product and explaining the choices
prompts.acceptance: Light, area and experience produce a reasoned demonstration kit; the choices can be saved locally and changed.

prompts.name: Rhythm Planner

variants.a: A typographic clock and a product demonstration
variants.b: A timeline workbench with an editor for three tasks

prompts.signature: Large time digits; bars matching the lengths; a rhythm driven by the input
prompts.acceptance: Three tasks and 0/5/10 min breaks; no break after the last one; recalculation, midnight and JSON/TXT export are exact.

prompts.name: Spine Editions

variants.a: A book-spine cover and three themed shelves
variants.b: An excerpt reading room with an edition index and a reading list

prompts.signature: A vertical book spine; margins and page numbers; original excerpts that open
prompts.acceptance: At least four original editions can be filtered, opened and added to a local list; clearing works.

prompts.name: Trail Composer

variants.a: A vertical trail diagram and outing moods
variants.b: A day plan sheet with linked stops and preparation

prompts.signature: A paper route; a finite path drawing; a vertical sequence of stops
prompts.acceptance: Length, pace and mood pick one of three clearly demonstrational plans; the preparation list and TXT export work.

prompts.name: Membrane Score

variants.a: A horizontal score of three light membranes
variants.b: A mood recipe index and an instrument of three vertical channels

prompts.signature: Three separate sound layers; membrane pulses driven by the settings; a visible recipe
prompts.acceptance: Play, pause, volume, mute, tempo, intensities, saving and restoring the recipe all work; the audio API fallback is honest.

prompts.name: Obsidian Stage

variants.a: A dark single-device story with five construction scenes
variants.b: A light comparison of three models and a selection desk

prompts.signature: A large metal object, three layers that open on scroll and a light summary with an exact price.
prompts.acceptance: Model, finish and storage change the image, the price and the local summary; the error, confirmation and reset all work.

prompts.name: Luminous Cut Vitrine

variants.a: A light collection display with one stone, portrait cards and a visit booking
variants.b: A single-piece page with metal, size and engraving choices

prompts.signature: One original 57-facet brilliant in an empty ivory display, turned by hand; the light in the facets changes in real time.
prompts.acceptance: The stone turns with mouse, touch and keyboard; metal and stone change the image and the exact price; booking errors, confirmation and clearing work.

prompts.name: Escapement Nocturne

variants.a: A dark three-chapter movement story with one sticky watch
variants.b: A personal watch configuration table with a price summary

prompts.signature: A watch running on real time whose dial opens on scroll to reveal its gear wheels; an original 3D movement with a static SVG.
prompts.acceptance: Case, dial and strap change the object, the exact price and the summary; date errors, the visit confirmation and clearing work.

prompts.name: Midnight Vestibule

variants.a: A night-time city hotel story with one-photograph sections
variants.b: A room gallery, comparison and booking drawer

prompts.signature: A full-screen night photograph whose lanterns come on once, and a booking drawer that slides in from the side with an exact nightly total.
prompts.acceptance: Calendar, guests, room and extras change the exact total; capacity and missing-step errors, the confirmation, reset and dialog focus all work.

prompts.name: Still Sanctuary

variants.a: A catalogue of regions with landscape rows, rituals and a stay enquiry
variants.b: The story of one place, its daily rituals and a choice of villas

prompts.signature: Three daily rituals change the photograph and the warm light of the page; a calm, large landscape and a real local enquiry.
prompts.acceptance: The time of day changes the real image, the text and the page background; region, dates and rituals are validated, the confirmation stays local and clearing works.

prompts.name: Heirloom Weave Ledger

variants.a: A century chronicle with an archive object and monogram that change on scroll
variants.b: A collection of portrait object studies and an initials personalisation workshop

prompts.signature: A monogram generated from initials; a scrolling century chronicle changes the objects and the monogram variants.
prompts.acceptance: Initials, thread colour and placement change the real object SVG; invalid initials and an unconfirmed demonstration are rejected; the summary and reset work.

prompts.name: Velvet Members Hall

variants.a: A private club introduction with rooms, a monthly programme and seat booking
variants.b: A personal invitation letter and a three-step membership application

prompts.signature: Folds of cherry velvet whose light responds to the pointer, a keyboard slider and touch.
prompts.acceptance: Membership level, club house and recommendation path with an exact summary; event dates and seat limits; errors, going back, reset and a local confirmation.

prompts.name: Patina Auction Room

variants.a: A filterable auction catalogue with viewing registration
variants.b: A single lot file with zoom and a local bid

prompts.signature: A spotlight follows the pointer; a native slider controls it with keyboard and touch.
prompts.acceptance: Category and estimate filters, zoom, six viewing times, minimum-step bids, the timer, errors, summary and reset.

prompts.name: Openwater Deck

variants.a: A yacht introduction with selectable deck zones, cabins and specifications
variants.b: A schematic route, week choice and a local charter enquiry

prompts.signature: A numbered deck plan opens a space's description, dimensions and area; the route changes a real schematic map.
prompts.acceptance: Four deck zones, two routes, three weeks, 1–8 guests; errors, an exact summary, editing and reset; local demonstration only.

prompts.name: Scent Ritual

variants.a: A four-scent collection, note layers and a personal sample set
variants.b: A three-question scent search, a note pyramid and an adjustable sample set

prompts.signature: An original WebGL glass bottle with refracted light and moving liquid; pointer, keyboard and touch control.
prompts.acceptance: All 27 three-question combinations, a clear recommendation, four scents, 1–3 unique samples, errors, an exact summary, editing and reset; a static 3D fallback.

prompts.name: Ember Course Room

variants.a: A ten-course evening with changing light
variants.b: A room plan and a local table booking

prompts.signature: Candlelit darkness, an evening course clock, warming light and a real choice of place in the room.
prompts.acceptance: Date and guest count recalculate free times, time and capacity recalculate tables; the summary stays local, editing and cancelling work.

prompts.name: Editorial Journal

variants.a: A literary issue cover with three departments and an editor's letter
variants.b: A long-form essay with a contents margin, a pull quote and an end note

prompts.signature: A large literary masthead, a narrow serif reading column, margin notes and original drawn illustrations instead of stock photos.
prompts.acceptance: Department links and essay contents reach real sections; the essay notes disclosure opens and closes with a keyboard; all reading content is visible without waiting for animation.

prompts.name: Newspaper Ledger

variants.a: A ruled multi-story front page with a lead plan, briefs and a chart
variants.b: One analysis article with a contents rail, a data table and method notes

prompts.signature: A dense ruled front page: a strong lead with an original labelled plan, unequal brief columns with a real chart, and an analysis page with a numeric ledger table and stated method.
prompts.acceptance: Every figure in the plan, chart and table adds up and carries its unit; the table is real selectable HTML with row and column headers; disclosures and section links work with a keyboard.

prompts.name: Field Notes

variants.a: An annotated travel fragment with a margin of notes and a route sketch
variants.b: A timed route diary with three stops and a preparation rail

prompts.signature: A notebook of observations: a narrative column beside margin notes, an original pencil sketch and a schematic route, each with a truthful caption, plus a timed diary.
prompts.acceptance: Fragment, route and diary links reach real sections; the source disclosures work; the three preparation checkboxes change state with mouse, touch and keyboard and say plainly that nothing is saved.

prompts.name: Botanical Engraving

variants.a: A plant and origin story led by one large leaf plate
variants.b: A classified three-plate herbarium with complete records

prompts.signature: Original fine-line plant plates with plate numbers, italic accepted names and observations, ordered like a labelled cabinet rather than a scattered collection.
prompts.acceptance: The three plates are distinct original drawings; every plate shows plate number, common name and italic accepted name; index links and native record disclosures work with a keyboard; the page states it is not an identification guide.

prompts.name: Swiss Grid

variants.a: A numbered service index with a large opening proposition
variants.b: An asymmetric work catalogue with a narrow identity rail

prompts.signature: A strict column grid with oversized left-aligned type, numbered ruled service rows, one red signal shape and generous empty space; no cards, photos or rounded UI.
prompts.acceptance: Navigation and the project index reach real sections; the engagement disclosure works with a keyboard; the contact area gives honest guidance instead of a fake form or broken email link.

prompts.name: Bauhaus Geometric

variants.a: An event poster grid with a timed programme
variants.b: A modular exhibition of three geometric composition studies

prompts.signature: Elementary circles, squares and triangles in red, blue and yellow that hold real grid modules beside large plain sans-serif type; a poster page and a three-study exhibition.
prompts.acceptance: Programme and exhibition links reach real sections; the practical-details disclosure works with a keyboard; no shape covers a control or text; no fake ticketing.

prompts.name: Neo Brutalist

variants.a: A loud event poster with a numbered manifesto
variants.b: A framed two-day programme with a working day filter

prompts.signature: Oversized poster words, thick black outlines, hard offset shadows and a loud yellow and violet palette, with a programme that really filters by day.
prompts.acceptance: The two day buttons show only that day’s sessions, expose aria-pressed and update a polite status line; the access disclosure works with a keyboard; the page states no tickets are sold and no data is collected.

prompts.name: Industrial Spec

variants.a: A dimensioned component sheet with a numbered assembly sequence
variants.b: Orthographic views with a two-envelope comparison ledger

prompts.signature: A technical document: a component ID beside an original dimensioned elevation, revision labels, unit-bearing spec rows and a comparison ledger whose drawings match the numbers.
prompts.acceptance: Drawing geometry matches the stated dimensions; spec values are selectable text with units; the comparison is a real HTML table; document-note disclosures work with a keyboard; no download, quote or buy action exists without a real destination.

prompts.name: Humanist Service

variants.a: A warm service introduction with tasks, people and a first step
variants.b: A patient three-step planner that builds a local session outline

prompts.signature: Warm serif invitations, original illustrations of people helping each other, plain task rows and a three-step planner that changes its guidance and shows a local outline.
prompts.acceptance: Topic radios replace the preparation list; the format radios change the note; submitting shows a local outline and focuses it; "Change my choices" returns focus to the topic; a service link can preselect a known topic; nothing is booked, saved or sent.

prompts.name: Institutional Clear

variants.a: A building directory with a lettered floor plan, search and visit notes
variants.b: One area guide with a zoomed plan, a numbered route rail and room options

prompts.signature: A public-building wayfinding system: a lettered floor plan, matching letter tiles in the directory, heavy sign-like rails, a working local search and dotted numbered routes.
prompts.acceptance: Search filters the four services by title and description, announces the count politely, shows an empty state and clears with a real button; plan letters, directory tiles and notes use the same codes; disclosures and route links work with a keyboard; no application or booking is implied.

prompts.name: Terminal Utility

variants.a: A service index of expandable command descriptions and a runbook
variants.b: A filterable chronological operations log with a run summary

prompts.signature: A readable command surface on dark green: monospace text index, expandable service commands with input and output, and a filterable timestamped log with text status labels.
prompts.acceptance: Service disclosures open with a keyboard and link to matching log entries; the log filter buttons expose aria-pressed and combine with the text search; the count and status bar update politely; a ?q= link opens the log pre-filtered; an empty state appears; nothing pretends to execute commands.

prompts.name: Data Observatory

variants.a: An overview with summary measures, a paired-dot chart and period buttons
variants.b: A searchable, sortable comparison table with stated extremes

prompts.signature: One small bundled dataset shown as plain-language findings, a paired-dot chart on a fixed scale with period buttons, and a sortable, searchable table with exact values.
prompts.acceptance: Q1/Q2 buttons update pressed state, summary measures, exact values and a polite status; dots are positioned from the data on one fixed 0–500 scale; the table search filters names with a count and empty message; header sort buttons reorder rows, set aria-sort and keep focus; all numbers agree.

prompts.name: Pop Commerce

variants.a: A bright single-product offer with finish, quantity and a demo bag
variants.b: A filterable three-product shelf with a demo bag

prompts.signature: Big saturated product stages with original illustrated objects, name and price side by side, a real finish and quantity choice and a local demo bag that calculates totals.
prompts.acceptance: Finish changes the illustration; quantity accepts whole numbers 1–9 with a clear error; the demo bag lists lines and totals, updates a polite status and header count, and clears; category buttons filter the shelf with pressed state and count; nothing pretends to be checkout, stock or payment.

prompts.name: Playful Cutout

variants.a: An assembled cutout scene inviting visitors to a making day
variants.b: An illustrated three-chapter story with sticker notes

prompts.signature: Original paper-cutout illustrations with pale cut edges that overlap inside reserved stages, warm playful colours and friendly big headings, with clear practical text beside them.
prompts.acceptance: Activity, notes and story links reach real sections; the chapter index works; practical disclosures open with a keyboard; no illustration covers text or a focused control, and none is a disguised button.

prompts.name: Kinetic Type

variants.a: An oversized word campaign with a manifesto and three verbs
variants.b: A two-day typographic programme with giant date numerals

prompts.signature: Huge words on a dark green ground with one acid accent, a short finite settling of the headline, and a programme where giant date numerals switch between two days.
prompts.acceptance: The headline settles once in under two seconds without fading or hiding; the two day buttons expose aria-pressed, keep focus, show only that day’s three sessions and update a polite status; reduced motion shows the final layout at once.

prompts.name: Retro Web

variants.a: A hand-kept personal portal with a sidebar directory
variants.b: A subject-filed archive with search and expandable entries

prompts.signature: A small hand-kept personal site: a centred page with a boxed sidebar directory, underlined links, a tiny CSS night sky, dated entries and a searchable subject archive.
prompts.acceptance: Subject buttons keep pressed state and combine with a case-insensitive search; the count, empty message and reset reflect the visible entries; each entry opens as a native disclosure; hidden entries leave the focus order; no fake guestbook, counter or live status.

prompts.name: Quiet Luxury

variants.a: One whole object, an enlarged material junction and a companion piece
variants.b: A collection document with shared-scale elevations and measured records

prompts.signature: One large object, then a sudden change of scale to an enlarged seam and timber junction, with notes placed beside the detail they explain and a measured collection document.
prompts.acceptance: Object codes and section links reach real destinations; elevations share one scale and match the dimensions written in HTML; the study-notes disclosure works with a keyboard; no price, purchase, availability or contact form.

prompts.name: Art Deco

variants.a: An axial evening invitation with a timed programme
variants.b: A house story with a stepped elevation and two room concepts

prompts.signature: A dark green and gold axial invitation crowned by a fan that links to the programme, fine double rules, stepped ornament that echoes the architecture, and a calm room index.
prompts.acceptance: The fan links to the three timed movements and every ornament leads to content; house and room links reach real sections; room-concept disclosures work with a keyboard; no ticket, booking, price or availability is implied.

prompts.name: Y2K Chrome

variants.a: A release poster with a chrome sphere and orbit and a track list
variants.b: An indexed collection of three chrome object editions

prompts.signature: Blunt oversized words beside a polished CSS chrome sphere with a tilted orbit, monospaced identifiers, and a real index of three object editions at changing scales.
prompts.acceptance: Release and collection links reach real sections; the numbered index reaches all three editions; volume disclosures work with a keyboard; text stays solid and selectable; no play, buy, stream or ticket control exists.

prompts.name: Soft Spatial

variants.a: A single ambient object lit in a small room
variants.b: A practice overview of three stepped layers

prompts.signature: Soft rounded CSS volumes lit from one window with real contact shadows, chalk, sage and blush materials, and generous space; depth without WebGL or motion.
prompts.acceptance: Every object shares one light direction and has a contact shadow; pill links reach real sections or pages; the scope disclosures work with a keyboard; text stays flat and readable; nothing can be booked or bought.
